module: Auxiliary low air pressure warning controller (heavy trucks). Monitors the pressure of a tank: below airTooLowPressure and with the ignition on (ignitionLevel > 0), it sets the warning electrics value to 1, plays a sound loop and displays a message; above airOkPressure or with the ignition off it resets everything to zero (hysteresis).
notes: jbeam keys read: lowAirWarningElectric ("lowAirPressure"), airTooLowPressure (600000 Pa relative) and airOkPressure (650000 Pa), both added to powertrain.currentEnvPressure, relevantPressureTankName ("mainAirTank"), lowAirWarningSoundEvent (audio event name, optional), lowAirWarningSoundNode (node name, 0 if absent), lowAirWarningSoundVolume (0.5).
If the tank does not exist, the pressure is considered 0 and the warning triggers as soon as the ignition is on.
The sound is an "AudioDefaultLoop3D" loop source created in initSounds.

init.desc: Reads the pressure thresholds and the monitored tank.

initSounds.desc: Creates the warning sound source (if lowAirWarningSoundEvent is defined) and sets its volume. Called by the engine at sound initialization.

reset.desc: Resets the warning electrics value to 0.

resetSounds.desc: Stops the warning sound and resets the playback state.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: compares the tank pressure to the thresholds and updates the warning electrics value, the sound and the message.
